exemplars.title: Portable Somatic Wearable: AI-Assisted Reflection Through Gaze-Derived Somatic Markers
exemplars.why: This is the clearest complete instance: an inferred three-level hesitation variable selects among three authored conversational behaviors—continuing the narrative, holding space, or pausing with affirmation.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It outranks rid 12905 because both the inferred states and their corresponding interaction strategies are fully enumerated, producing a richer and more legible lookup than a two-way difficulty adjustment.

exemplars.title: Enhancing Perceived Empathy in Empathic Mixed Reality Agents via Context-Aware Adaptation
exemplars.why: The direction of physiological arousal functions as a discrete user-state variable that selects between two explicit, bounded difficulty behaviors: remove half the drones or add drones up to eight.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It outranks rid 9078 because the evidence states the complete signal-to-behavior mapping, whereas rid 9078 does not enumerate its question types or template inventory.

exemplars.title: Ask, Verify, Refine: A Question-Aware Multimodal XUI with Feedback-Guided Refinement for Clinical Verification
exemplars.why: A predicted user-intent variable explicitly routes the response through an authored explanation template and determines which evidence and justification fields appear.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: It edges out rid 6229 because it explicitly describes a selection mechanism and the resulting changes to explanation content, while rid 6229 only says that unspecified UI components are tailored to each intent.

notes: I departed from the consensus by promoting rid 12905 from fifth to second because its evidence supplies an unusually complete two-branch mapping, and by excluding consensus-third rid 16714 because its excerpt names adaptive modes but never specifies which inferred states select them. I retained rid 9078 over rid 6229 because its routing operation and output consequences are clearer, although its finite set of question types and templates is not enumerated in the supplied quote. Readers should distrust any implication of demonstrated effectiveness: the evidence establishes mechanisms, not outcomes. Rid 12905 also operationalizes user state through rising versus falling SCL rather than named categorical states, and the evidence for rid 9078 leaves the authored behavior inventory implicit.
